decisions.compatibility_effect: Controller binary, command graph, transport, canonical record format, and all exact argv become qualification identity and require a new clean no-authority release.
evidence: ADR-0051 requires a separate hash-bound qualification tool and split Q15-R/Q15-W authority.
ADR-0054 requires one literal buffer mapping to survive Q15-R sealing and the later Q15-W transaction.
The clean Q15-S3 release contains fixed probe/collector components but intentionally exposes no production command that starts them.
decisions.gate: Before a clean controller-bearing no-authority bundle and before any Q15-R authorization can be issued.
options_considered: Use ad-hoc shell orchestration around component APIs.
Add arbitrary collector selectors to cpu_prefetch_q15_tool.
Add one statically fixed fail-closed controller and authorization-v2 command graph.
Declare the stand ineligible and stop.
decisions.recommended_option: Add one statically fixed fail-closed controller and authorization-v2 command graph; preserve stand-ineligible as the fallback.
decisions.scientific_effect: None; the controller only acquires qualification evidence and cannot access scientific schedules, namespaces, outcomes, calibration, pilot, measurement, or analysis.
decisions.supersession_rule: Any graph, transport, role, executable, authorization-format, same-buffer, or canonicalization change requires a new ADR, clean release, and requalification; scientific changes require protocol review.

decisions.classification: least-privilege identity and two-domain custody engineering
decisions.compatibility_effect: Principal IDs, key fingerprints, effective groups/capabilities, output root, custody-domain IDs, policies, and receipt format become authorization identity.
evidence: ADR-0050 requires four distinct effective identities, negative access evidence, and two distinct custody domains.
Read-only storage evidence establishes /dev/md3 as one candidate stand domain and the development repository as a separate-machine domain, but does not establish accounts or permissions.
decisions.gate: Before role/custody setup, and again before Q15-R issuance with actual account, key, permission, capability, and negative-access evidence.
options_considered: Reuse the root SSH identity for all roles.
Use labels without distinct effective credentials.
Use four exact least-privilege principals and two hash-verified custody domains.
Declare the stand ineligible and stop.
decisions.recommended_option: Use the exact four principal IDs and custody policy/domain IDs in this record; actual accounts, keys, groups, capabilities, permissions, and negative tests remain separately authorized stand evidence.
decisions.scientific_effect: None; this separates execution, mutation, custody, and verification and cannot change a treatment or observation.
decisions.supersession_rule: Any identity, credential, permission, capability, domain, path, quota, or custody-policy change requires a new prospective authorization and fresh negative evidence.

decisions.classification: prospective resource, validity, and watchdog limits
decisions.compatibility_effect: Every numerical bound and stop condition is part of Q15-R authorization identity; later changes require a new record rather than editing evidence.
evidence: ADR-0048 requires exact nonzero start-barrier poll limits and an external process watchdog selected prospectively.
ADR-0045 requires exact byte, time, artifact, custody, and stop limits and rejects unbounded authority.
The clock contract fixes 100000 prime reads, 10000000 deltas per core, and three 100000-exchange cross-core windows spanning at least 60 seconds each.
decisions.gate: Before controller implementation freezes these fields and before Q15-R issuance binds issue/expiry timestamps and actual limits.
options_considered: Derive limits from qualification or scientific outcomes.
Freeze conservative finite outer bounds prospectively and use maximum u64 only for the two pre-start poll counters.
Declare the stand ineligible and stop.
decisions.recommended_option: Freeze the exact limits and stop conditions in this record. The u64 poll bounds do not replace the independent 60-second start watchdog; no in-measurement poll-count limit is introduced.
decisions.scientific_effect: None if applied only to pre-start and external qualification containment. Limit expiry produces retained invalid/incomplete qualification evidence and never selects or tunes a treatment.
decisions.supersession_rule: Changing a limit or stop condition requires a new prospective decision/authorization; no value may be adjusted from observed treatment effects or scientific outcomes.

decisions.classification: approval, signature, issuance, and phase-authority governance
decisions.compatibility_effect: Canonical authorization bytes, signature namespace/scheme, signer identity, validity interval, and all bound artifacts become immutable authority identity.
evidence: ADR-0045 requires a prospective hash-bound authorization and rejects generic approval or root access as authority.
ADR-0051 requires Q15-R and Q15-W to be separately signed, with Q15-W depending on sealed Q15-R evidence.
The current request is to prepare a decision/input bundle, not to access or qualify the stand.
decisions.gate: This approval precedes repository-local closure only; a later exact Q15-R authorization with actual hashes, identities, timestamps, argv, and signature must be approved separately.
options_considered: Treat approval of this bundle as Q15-R execution authority.
Treat prior SSH permission as continuing qualification authority.
Authorize repository-local blocker closure only and require later signed Q15-R issuance approval.
decisions.recommended_option: Authorize repository-local blocker closure only, use the exact detached-signature policy, and require a later explicit approval over the final signed Q15-R record.
decisions.scientific_effect: None; this bundle grants no stand, qualification, calibration, pilot, measurement, analysis, or confirmatory authority.
decisions.supersession_rule: A change to signature scheme, canonicalization, signer, issuance process, phase split, or authority boundary requires a new governance decision and new immutable authorization.
